changeSet.author: emcip-team
changeSet.comment: Change rules_enabled from jsonb to text. The GroupProfile entity maps this field as a Java String. R2DBC PostgreSQL driver rejects binding String to jsonb (error 42804: "column is of type jsonb but expression is of type character varying"). Storing as text is equivalent since the values are JSON strings and no jsonb-specific operators are used in queries.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE group_profiles ALTER COLUMN rules_enabled TYPE text USING rules_enabled::text, ALTER COLUMN rules_enabled SET DEFAULT '[]'

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE group_profiles ALTER COLUMN rules_enabled TYPE jsonb USING rules_enabled::jsonb, ALTER COLUMN rules_enabled SET DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
